text: A frog lived at the bottom of a well so deep
Above him just one circle of the sky to keep
That is the whole sky, he said, I have seen it all
One day a sea turtle looked down the wall
Come up, said the turtle, the sky is far bigger
The frog just laughed, bigger than my sky, impossible
So the turtle told him of the sea
Wider than a thousand wells, deeper than the mountains are tall
The frog said nothing, then for the first time he climbed
And the sky had no edge at all
Your sky is only as big as your well
